articles.summary: Mar. 26, 2025- Mannatech, Incorporated (NASDAQ: MTEX), a global health and wellness company committed to transforming lives to make a better world, today announced financial results for its fourth quarter of 2024. Quarter End Results Fourth quarter net sales for 2024 were $29.0 million , a decrease of $3.7 million , or 11.3%, as compared to $32.7 million in the fourth quarter of 2023.
